raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. cutting part of knife, sword, etc, mata (+ approp n): the penknife ~, mata pisau lipat; 2. flattened part of oar etc, daun (dayung dll); 3. also razor ~, mata pisau cukur; 4. leaf of grass, cereal, etc, lai (daun); 5. also ~ – bone, tulang belikat; 6. (phon) daun lidah; 7. dashing person, (orang yg) bergaya: a gay ~, orang yg bergaya dan periang. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
